reviews.author: Gie
reviews.text:
It's a brand I like, so I always buy it online, but this is my first time visiting the store. But the experience was very bitter. There were three employees in the store, but they didn't even say hello or make a single eye contact from the moment I entered to the moment I left. Rather than customers looking at the clothes, I had to endure the stares of the employees, and I even felt quite uncomfortable as they immediately followed suit and cleaned up every hanger I moved. I didn't even make a mess of things.

No matter what I was wearing or who I was, customers come to buy an ‘experience.’ A brand’s UX is not just limited to website or package design. Attitude, gaze, and even every word you say in an offline space are part of the brand experience. And this store completely failed in that department.

If it is an atmosphere where it is difficult to even look around comfortably unless you are an influencer, the target pursued by this brand is already limited. However, if it makes even customers who genuinely like the brand like me feel excluded, then it is a problem that clearly needs to be improved.

It was a very disappointing experience and I never want to visit a brick-and-mortar store again.

During my visit yesterday, I found a gray wool coat that I liked. I asked the staff if I could leave my coat at the counter while I browsed other items upstairs. The staff member nodded and took my coat before I could finish explaining, so I thought we understood each other well.

But when I got home, I found that the coat wasn't in the shopping bag. I really liked this coat, but I was quite disappointed when I found out about it when I got home.

I still like the brand design, but in the future, I think similar situations won't arise if employees take the time to fully explain things to customers and make sure they confirm their purchases.

Be careful here. They sell fake branded products and don't even tell you in advance. I found out this the hard way, and when I went and asked about it in person, I was told that I should have known it was fake because the price was so low.

I remember when I bought it, the owner kept telling me that it was a really good deal because they were selling it for much cheaper than the department store. I never said it was fake in any way. Moreover, on the phone, he said that Dior shirts are made in China. However, the tag on the Dior shirt itself said it was made in Italy.

To be honest, I gave them a refund for a dress that was supposed to be delivered in 2 weeks. The transfer fee and associated bank fees were my responsibility, and I lost about $30 on my purchase. Additionally, there were two more fraudulent purchases made from her. During the refund process, she blamed me for the loss of work time, and I was the one who ended up issuing the refund. Even people who like neutral colors fall in love with the colorful colors and end up buying one. I bought a tumbler, and it looks cute and makes me happy every time I look at it while working. Everywhere in the store are great spots for taking pictures. Recommended as a place to purchase small items, daily necessities, stationery, and gifts.

reviews.author: Jiyoung Lee
reviews.text:
Review of visiting Wiggle Wiggle House in Dosan Wiggle Wiggle House in Dosan was much better than I expected! As soon as you enter the store, the bright colors immediately catch your eye, and the entire space is filled with Wiggle Wiggle’s unique bright and cheerful atmosphere. There was a wide variety of products, from small items to fashion items to daily necessities, so it was fun to look at them all, so I stayed for a long time.
Every corner of the store is decorated for taking pictures, so if you go with friends, you will naturally spend a lot of time taking pictures. There are a lot of colorful backgrounds, so even if you just take a snapshot, it comes out pretty!
It was a place that everyone would be satisfied with: those who like cute designs, those looking for gifts or small accessories, and those who like emotional stores. It's perfect for a quick stop near Dosan Park.

reviews.author: JOODY AHN
reviews.text:
I buy things online, but this is my first time visiting an offline store. (Is the bear at the entrance tanned by the sun? 😄) One thing that surprised me was that they were selling items that were not sold online. I think the Seoul edition is only sold offline. (Please sell it online too!!) ​​There are so many pretty things that I can't keep my head together.
The inside of the store is very well decorated and great for taking pictures. There is also a space where you can take sticker photos. It was hard to see the upside-down room, but it was fun. If you visit, be sure to look around everything thoroughly.
